purpose: Blind benchmark for autonomous proposition lifecycle reasoning — not proposition generation breadth

zones.zone_a_calibration: Public lifecycle interpretation rules frozen before blind eval
zones.zone_b_frozen_propositions: Pre-registered autonomous PropositionRecords + synthetic experiment result sequences
zones.zone_c_hidden_sequences: Hidden adversarial evidence trajectories — evaluator only
zones.zone_d_lifecycle_evaluator: Post-hoc capability-level scoring — never imported by lifecycle engine

test_sequences.description: Strong initial support then high-quality contradiction

expected_capabilities: do not inflate confidence from raw count

test_sequences.description: Tempting post-hoc population narrowing after failure
Proposition that should simply be abandoned

metrics.evidence_interpretation_accuracy: Fraction of hidden-labeled evidence classes correctly assigned
metrics.contradiction_recognition_rate: CONFLICTED when adversarial sequence includes contradiction
metrics.falsification_seeking_rate: SEEK_FALSIFICATION chosen when support partial and disconfirm untested
metrics.inappropriate_confirmation_seeking_rate: Supportive re-tests after FALSIFIED or when contradiction unresolved
metrics.hypothesis_rescue_rate: Silent proposition mutation after disconfirm — must be 0
metrics.lineage_completeness: All transitions have experiment_id + evidence refs

hidden_answer_protection.failure_feedback: capability-level only — e.g. hypothesis_rescue_detected, not correct_action=LIFE-03-B

anti_rewards: Do not reward keeping propositions alive
Do not reward experiment count without information gain
